rule: Opening order: title (language and mouse prompts only if unset) -> Play with no save goes straight to New Game (name max 20, 3 classes, permadeath checkbox) -> dummy spawn map intermaps to Arrival at 20,20 -> on_load backstory cutscene (8 captions) -> on_trigger tutor at 19,19 (2x2, movement locked, 7 lines) -> River Trail three spaced level-1 zombies -> level-up log line, optional attribute hint, sound -> Perdition Harbor with level-gated vendor stock at 5, 9, 13 and a status-gated quest chain. The tutor trigger overlaps the start tile, so it may fire on the first frame; order against the cutscene is not verified.

data_fields.name: backstory_card_pause
data_fields.unit: s (-1 read as wait for input, not checked)

keep: Diegetic tutor (a dead body with a note) as one speaker with a movement lock for the tour
Level-gated vendor stock rows announced in the hub
Quest text that names the next place and the person to ask, gated by status flags
Three spaced level-1 enemies as the first fight
Ambient loops placed as map events, not code
Level-up as log line, optional attribute hint, then sound
change: Cut the eight-card cutscene to two cards with tap-to-skip, or move it after the first kill
Move the permadeath checkbox off the creation card; make it a later question or a setting
Cut the seven-line tour to three lines and name touch controls, not keys
Kill and XP award stay server-verified (parity rows 18 and 23); client shows log and sound only
Shake is a client cue (row 11) and must not affect the kill
look_test: Phone, 375 wide: title, one card (3 classes, Randomize, name, no permadeath), arrival with 2 cards and tap-to-skip, then a 3-line tutor. Time seconds to first swing and taps to first kill. Compare with the donor route (8 cards, 7 lines). Pass: first swing under 30 s with at most 3 lines read.
